interco_sud.about: Trains between regions round Paris: 10.2 million passengers in 1999, 21.9 million in 2009, of which 17.6 million on trains through the Île-de-France stations and 4.3 million on trains that avoid the region; about 40% of them start or end at Roissy, Marne-la-Vallée or Massy
